case_title: CHUNG SON SUN VS SVENDAHL EDEN DEANN et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,000.00 FILED BY CHUNG SON SUN AS TO DEFENDANT SVENDAHL EDEN DEANN THOMPSON SCOTT MARTIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-28-1992 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT THOMPSON SCOTT MARTIN

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CHUNG SON SUN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT THOMPSON SCOTT MARTIN $2,900.00 PRINCIPAL, $8.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,908.00, $1100.00 DEDUCTED FOR LACK OF HEAT. ONLY THOMPSON WAS SERVE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
